verdict.rationale: Docs state you can 'bring your own compute' and 'run the HumanLayer stack on your workstation or remote workers,' implying self-hosting of the daemon/agent runtime, but there is no documentation of self-hosting the core SaaS product (task management, web UI, integrations) which appears tied to app.humanlayer.com. Missing for 10: explicit self-host install guide/docker/helm for the core platform, licensing terms for self-hosted use, and independent confirmation of a fully self-hosted deployment.
